note: resolved in the INC-77 postmortem that any parallelism added to the profile enrichment batch loader must cap the number of requests running at the same time to eight. the trigger was a speed-up that fired every request in the batch simultaneously; a routine 4,000-id backfill opened thousands of concurrent connections, tripped the upstream profile API's rate limiter, and got our client blocked for two hours while support cleared it. the review conclusion was that firing a whole batch at once is never acceptable against that API — parallel is fine, but only a handful of requests may be outstanding at any moment

the upstream profile API team confirmed after INC-77 that they will not raise our throttle; they asked us to keep a batch run of the enrichment loader to at most eight requests outstanding at a time and said anything above that risks the automated block again
